records.question: Every week, Lucas makes 4 pieces of chocolate candy for each of his students on Monday. He made 40 pieces of chocolate candy last Monday. This upcoming Monday, 3 of Lucas' students will not be coming to class. How many pieces of chocolate candy will Lucas make for his class on Monday?
records.response:
If 40 pieces of chocolate candy were made last Monday and Lucas made 4 pieces for each of his students, Lucas made 40/4=10 students.
If Lucas made 10 students and 3 of them won't be coming to class, Lucas will make 10-3=7 students.
If Lucas makes 4 pieces of chocolate candy for each of his students, Lucas will make 7*4=28 pieces of chocolate candy for his class.
#### 28

records.question: It takes 7 years for an apple tree to bear fruit. If Lydia planted a tree when she was 4 years old and is now 9 years old, how old would she be when she gets to eat an apple from her tree for the first time?
records.response:
Lydia has already been 9-4 = 5 years old.
It will take 7-5 = 2 more years for the tree to bear fruit.
Therefore, Lydia will be 9+2 = 11 years old when she gets to eat an apple from her tree for the first time.
